author: Michael Larabel
description: In addition to the recent influx of Linux security vulnerabilities affecting Linux, FreeBSD has also begun receiving security reports via AI/LLM-driven discovery tools. FreeBSD 15.1-RC1 is out today ahead of the planned official release in June and it brings a handful of security fixes out of this new AI-driven security research space...
title: FreeBSD 15.1-RC1 Released: Fixes With Now Seeing More AI-Discovered Security Issues

author: Michael Larabel
description: GNOME Commander, the orthodox file manager for the GNOME desktop that was inspired by Norton Commander, has been rewritten in the Rust programming language and also now using the GTK4 toolkit...
title: GNOME Commander 2.0 Released Following Rewrite In Rust & GTK4

author: Michael Larabel
description: Merged today for Linux 7.1 was this week's power management fixes with a few notable fixes for both AMD and Intel platforms...
title: Linux 7.1 Merges AMD Dynamic EPP Fixes, Intel Bartlett Lake Scaling Fix

author: Michael Larabel
description: Released earlier this month was the OpenCL 3.1 specification with a focus on enhancing AI and HPC workloads for this long-time Khronos specification. Out today is OpenCL 3.1.1 as a point release with an emphasis on addressing a possible performance regression of OpenCL 3.1...
title: OpenCL 3.1.1 Released To Address A Possible Performance Regression

author: Michael Larabel
description: The first release candidate of systemd 261 is out today and it includes yet more features for this Linux init system and service manager...
title: systemd 261-rc1 Released With OS Installer, IMDS Subsystem & New storagectl

author: Michael Larabel
description: Last month with the new AMD Zen 5 "Dual Edition" 3D V-Cache CPU, the AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 Dual Edition showed great performance on Linux across a range of workloads. Curious if the operating system was playing into the greater benefit of Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 versus just the workloads tested, this article is looking at both the AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D and Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 on Microsoft Windows 11 and Ubuntu 26.04 LTS Linux across a range of native benchmarks.
title: Linux Provides Better Performance With The AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 Over Windows 11

author: Michael Larabel
description: For those with a new Core Ultra Series 3 "Panther Lake" laptop from HP or considering one of these new systems, the Intel ISH firmware has now been upstreamed to linux-firmware.git for enhancing the out-of-the-box support...
title: HP Panther Lake Systems Now Have Intel ISH Firmware For Linux

author: Michael Larabel
description: The AMD SoC Power Management Controller Driver is the latest seeing patch activity now in preparing for next-gen Zen 6 processors...
title: AMD PMC Linux Driver Preps For Zen 6 CPUs

author: Michael Larabel
description: A new proposal volleyed today among LLVM developers is for Multi-Thread Parallel Compilation "MTPC" for the ThinLTO link-time optimization code. This is great news for today's high core count CPUs when looking to compile very large LLVM modules...
title: Proposed Multi-Thread Parallel Compilation "MTPC" For LLVM Is Great News

author: Michael Larabel
description: A set of 42 patches were posted on Thursday for the AMDGPU kernel driver and associated AMDKFD compute driver code for enabling pipe reset capabilities for compute workloads...
title: Expanded Reset Support Coming For AMDGPU To Recover From More GPU Compute Hangs

author: Michael Larabel
description: It's not only the Linux networking subsystem where many fixes have been appearing -- including several notable security fixes for local privilege escalation issues -- leading to "craziness" from AI / LLMs. The Linux sound subsystem has also been seeing an uptick in activity with many "assisted-by" patches coming about in recent weeks...
title: Linux Sound Subsystem Also Seeing Many Fixes Driven By AI/LLMs
